title: Current Action Validation Route After Architect Review
repairTrigger: WC06 Operator validation failed because current action routed to Full Work Card creation required / Ad Hoc Work Card Capture instead of WC06 Operator validation.
problem: The app treats WC06 as needing full Work Card creation even though the full Work Card, Implementer Report, and Architect Review exist. The routed workspace opens Ad Hoc Work Card Capture instead of Human Validation.
goal: Route WC06 to Operator validation after Architect Review when no passing validation report exists, and prevent routing back to full Work Card creation for an existing numbered Work Card.
includedScope: Recognize existing WC06 Work Card artifacts
Stop routing WC06 to full Work Card creation when artifacts exist
Route Architect-reviewed WC06 to Operator validation
Ensure routed workspace is Human Validation rather than Ad Hoc Work Card Capture
Preserve WC04 validation and repair behavior
Add fixture coverage for the failed routing scenario
outOfScope: Provider SDKs, cloud services, database, auth, browser automation, MCP passthrough, connectors, or deployment code
acceptanceCriteria: Current action no longer routes WC06 to Full Work Card creation required when the WC06 Work Card exists
Current action routes WC06 to Operator validation after Architect Review and before passing validation
Routed workspace is Human Validation rather than Ad Hoc Work Card Capture
Current-action panel and workflow guide agree on WC06 validation state
WC06 does not advance to WC07 before validation passes
Focused fixture coverage exists for the failed routing scenario
